data.name: Nurist Biocarbon
data.description: Nurist Biocarbon Private Limited is an early-stage Indian biochar producer based in Didwana, Nagaur district, Rajasthan. It converts crop residues and invasive Prosopis juliflora into biochar used as a soil amendment on degraded arid land, claiming a partnership with CAZRI and a pilot that reclaimed 50 acres in Barmer. Biochar production and sale of associated carbon credits is the company's core business.
